name: Codebase canvas discovery
description: Pinned working-tree source at HEAD 8ca143700ca4d2c870f1101b8cd4601ab68abd41; 1044 files. All generation, prompt authoring and judges: gpt-6-astra/high, n=1. Six initial variants; judge selects two for three rounds at each phase. Status: cancelled. Generation cancelled.

phases.name: Phase 1 · Identify epicenters
phases.description: Astra/high authors two variations, then three discovery conditions inspect the same pinned codebase. n=1 each; select important points rather than full coverage.

phases.name: Phase 2 · Generate trees
phases.description: Six conditions share three discovery outputs. One tree per point; paired minimal and verbatim 3+1 prompts use identical six synthetic examples.

phases.name: Phase 3 · Expand canvases
phases.description: Each seed and its backing source produce one connected central/peripheral canvas using the pinned extension task.

phases.name: Phase 4 · Judge and improve
phases.description: One selection judge chooses two variants. Each gets three independent phase-targeted branches, three critique/regeneration rounds per branch. Every judge evaluates the complete phase output and all final canvases for one variant. Exactly 18 phase critiques: two variants, three target phases, three rounds. No fourth terminal judge.

phases.name: Superseded attempts
phases.description: Archive of the incorrectly scoped per-point judges. Retained for provenance and cost accounting; excluded from the corrected Phase 4 improvement branches.
